title: A Record-Breaking Loading Capacity for Single-Molecule Magnet Mn12 Clusters Achieved in a Mesoporous Ln-MOF

source_locations.location: main text, structural discussion and Figure 1
main text, paragraph beginning “MOF 1 was synthesized”

list_of_rare_earth_compounds.structure_description: One of the homochiral crystal forms obtained by spontaneous resolution of racemic lactic acid. It crystallizes in chiral space group P6₃22. Helical La–ligand chains connect through hydroxyisophthalate ligands into a three-dimensional framework with one-dimensional mesoporous channels along the c-axis.

synthesis.procedure: Reaction of lanthanum nitrate hexahydrate, 5-hydroxyisophthalic acid, and racemic lactic acid in DMF/i-PrOH produces compound 1; spontaneous resolution yields homochiral 1R and 1S crystals. The main article gives no numerical reagent quantity.
synthesis.time: 2 days at 120 °C; initial stirring duration unspecified
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Crystallizes as homochiral 1R crystals within a conglomerate.
synthesis.yield: 45% based on H3L for the combined 1R/1S preparation; individual yields not reported

list_of_rare_earth_compounds.structure_description: The homochiral form described in detail by single-crystal analysis; it crystallizes in P6₃22. Lactate and hydroxyisophthalate link La(III) ions into helical chains approximately 1.5 nm wide along the c-axis. Hydroxyisophthalate links each chain to four neighboring chains, forming a three-dimensional mesoporous framework with one-dimensional channels approximately 2.0 nm across.

synthesis.procedure: Reaction of lanthanum nitrate hexahydrate, 5-hydroxyisophthalic acid, and racemic lactic acid in DMF/i-PrOH produces compound 1; spontaneous resolution yields homochiral 1R and 1S crystals. The main article gives no numerical reagent quantity.
synthesis.time: 2 days at 120 °C; initial stirring duration unspecified
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Crystallizes as homochiral 1S crystals within a conglomerate.
synthesis.yield: 45% based on H3L for the combined 1R/1S preparation; individual yields not reported
